topic.topicDisplayName: RA in pregnancy: disease course, drug safety, biologics, MTX cessation
topic.coverageNote: Drug-safety statements are taken from this review. A 2020 ACR reproductive guideline was not the open full text retrieved.

mcqs.question: Why does the review call methotrexate absolutely contraindicated in pregnancy?

options.A: Category X, with risk of spontaneous abortion and embryopathy affecting heart, central nervous system, and skeleton
options.B: Category B, safe in the second trimester
options.C: It does not cross the placenta
options.D: Risk is limited to maternal hypertension

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Category X, with risk of spontaneous abortion and embryopathy affecting heart, central nervous system, and skeleton
mcqs.explanation: Methotrexate is category X because of spontaneous abortion and embryopathy of the heart, central nervous system, and skeleton.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Open Access Rheumatology: Research and Reviews
sourceRefs.excerpt: The absolute contraindication to methotrexate (MTX) (category X) during pregnancy is secondary to the risk of spontaneous abortion and MTX embryopathy characterized by a combination of abnormalities impacting the heart, central nervous system, and skeleton.

mcqs.question: Can the review identify a methotrexate dose that is safe in the first trimester?

options.A: No. Case reports of uncomplicated low-dose exposure do not establish a dose low enough to counsel as risk-free
options.B: Yes, 7.5 mg weekly is stated to be safe
options.E: The review does not discuss dose

mcqs.correctAnswerText: No. Case reports of uncomplicated low-dose exposure do not establish a dose low enough to counsel as risk-free
mcqs.explanation: There are case reports of first-trimester low-dose exposure without anomalies, but the review says there does not appear to be a low enough dose that exposure can be counselled as posing no risk.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Open Access Rheumatology: Research and Reviews
sourceRefs.excerpt: there does not appear to be a low enough dose that a pregnant patient can be counseled on that the MTX exposure will not pose any risk.

mcqs.question: How are leflunomide and sulfasalazine classified for pregnancy in this review?

options.A: Leflunomide category X and avoided even when pregnancy is years away because of a long half-life; sulfasalazine category B and may be continued
options.D: Leflunomide is continued and sulfasalazine is stopped

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Leflunomide category X and avoided even when pregnancy is years away because of a long half-life; sulfasalazine category B and may be continued
mcqs.explanation: Leflunomide is category X and should be avoided even if pregnancy is planned in coming years because of its long half-life. Sulfasalazine is category B and can be continued.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Open Access Rheumatology: Research and Reviews
sourceRefs.excerpt: It should be avoided in women who will be pursuing pregnancy even in the upcoming years due to its long half-life.

mcqs.question: What congenital-anomaly signal does the review report for etanercept or infliximab?

options.A: An FDA-database review found 41 children with 61 anomalies, discussed alongside VACTERL case reports
options.B: No anomaly has ever been reported
options.D: The signal was an excess of neural-tube defects proven in a randomized trial

mcqs.correctAnswerText: An FDA-database review found 41 children with 61 anomalies, discussed alongside VACTERL case reports
mcqs.explanation: Exposure has been linked with VACTERL association in case reports and, in an FDA-database review, 41 children had 61 congenital anomalies after etanercept or infliximab exposure.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Open Access Rheumatology: Research and Reviews
sourceRefs.excerpt: There were 41 children with a total of 61 anomalies in the setting of exposure to etanercept or infliximab

mcqs.question: How did infant drug levels differ between certolizumab and infliximab?

options.A: Certolizumab was undetectable in all infants by the assay used; every infliximab infant had a cord or blood level higher than the mother's, median cord-to-maternal ratio 160%
options.B: Both drugs were absent from cord blood
options.C: Certolizumab levels exceeded maternal levels in every infant
options.D: Infliximab does not cross the placenta

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Certolizumab was undetectable in all infants by the assay used; every infliximab infant had a cord or blood level higher than the mother's, median cord-to-maternal ratio 160%
mcqs.explanation: Certolizumab infants all had undetectable concentrations. Every infliximab infant had a cord or blood level above the mother's, median cord-to-maternal ratio 160%, and infliximab often stayed detectable for months.

sourceRefs.sourceBody: Open Access Rheumatology: Research and Reviews
